name: Elder Triple Screen with MACD trend, oscillator pullback, stop entry
author: Alexander Elder / RoboForex summary

indicators.screen 1: EMA(13) and MACD histogram(12,26,9) on longest timeframe
indicators.screen 2: Stochastic(5,3,3) or selected oscillator on middle timeframe
indicators.screen 3: trailing stop entry on shortest timeframe

entry_long: Only in long trend; pullback in middle timeframe; place trailing buy stop above prior bar
entry_short: Only in short trend; middle-timeframe rally; place trailing sell stop below prior bar
exit: Exit rule not fully specified in summary
stop_loss: Long stop behind 2-day low; short behind 2-day high after trigger
filters: Trade only direction of longest-timeframe trend
implementation_notes: Second-screen oscillator options differ; choose one before implementation. Third-screen exact update schedule needs primary-source check.
